items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Then I played a couple of jobs with him. But I never played... I never was a real member of them.

ctx.x: Oh, you mentioned you played a little bit with Buddy Petit? Oh yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. When I was a little kid. Okay. Then I played a couple of jobs with him. But I never played... I never was a real member of them. Never a regular member. But you know our bands do. Swap up men like that.
